sections.title: Life cycle and habitat
sections.text: A small annual of temporary wet meadows in the western United States, especially California and Idaho. It grows in depressions flooded during the wet season and later dried out.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Plants are usually 5–25 cm tall, sometimes reaching 40 cm. The bilateral blue to violet flowers have white and yellow markings; the elongated capsule is about 2–5.5 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the references consulted.
